text_block_list.text:
Judging from our training situation, we 
can still adjust our course toward the 
Kikuka Sho from here.

If you want to clear up your doubts with 
actual racing experience, you could enter 
the 2,200m right-handed St. Lite Kinen. In 
any case—
choice_data_list: (First, we need to talk it over!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boss!!
choice_data_list: Meno! Just the person I was looking for!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, excuse me! There is a matter I would 
like to discuss!

"Convinced that our intentions were one 
and the same, I opened my mouth..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: This is currently my situation, sir...!
choice_data_list: What kind of situation is this!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I had been acting for the sake 
of contributing to the future of 
children."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As a result, she came to be adored by 
children and juniors alike. She had taken 
her first step as an ally of justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, I feel everything has been 
going smoothly, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—When you think about it, weren't we all 
just dancing in the palm of Golshi-san's 
hand?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I truly believe that from the bottom of 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Am I not serving the justice I envisioned, 
but merely acting as a puppet in a 
momentary, amusing farce?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—In the truest sense, am I truly 
fulfilling my purpose?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We cannot allow things to simply go her 
way like this!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I have to become strong as my own person! 
With enough power and charm to never lose 
to her!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—If being adored simply ends at being 
amusing, then I haven't accomplished any 
of my duties!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a clown that I wanted to become. 
It was a champion of justice who could 
guide children...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As a champion of justice, I must captivate 
the children...! Without that power...! I 
am—!

"...Right now, Fenomeno stands right in 
the middle of a swaying balance scale."

What I could point out to her was another 
possible path.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Fenomeno isn't running in the Kikuka 
Sho!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently so. She's running in the Autumn 
Tenno Sho. If she wins in her Classic 
year, she'll be only the third in history 
to pull it off, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It's such a shame to miss a showdown with 
Gold Ship at the Kikuka Sho, isn't it~? 
I'm sure it would've been thrilling...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Well, whatever. More importantly, right 
now... ...I need to interview that big 
shot."

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre-san! What you're aiming for next 
is the title of the world's best, right?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle of dreams that Japan has 
never reached! Please—take 1st place in 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
"The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is the 
world's premier race, one where Japanese 
Umamusume have challenged time and again, 
only to face defeat."

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
When I heard our nation's strongest Triple 
Crown Umamusume was taking on the 
challenge, I just had to come!

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
To think that we might finally witness the 
long-cherished moment of a Japanese 
Umamusume reaching the pinnacle of the 
world...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Just a few words will do. Could we please 
get a comment?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: All of Japan is watching you...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Aaah...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, members of the press. I 
understand very well how you must feel.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, that action just now was her own 
way of sending a message.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Look upon me, everyone. ...Behold my back.

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? What about my back...?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh—
(RUUUUMBLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...! Such power...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it...! Orfevre is truly going 
after the world! She will surely show us 
the view from the very top!

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
I have to keep chasing her...! Her story 
is what everyone wants to see...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Magazines, TV, everything...! A special 
feature on this girl—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Gold Ship-san. Eating in such a 
weird way again... Eating shaved ice 
without syrup...

The noble lady of the Mejiro family, 
Mejiro McQueen. She sighs in exasperation 
as she calls out to Gold Ship, who follows 
her around constantly.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, it really is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Dammit! Hang on, Mac-chan! I'll bring 
back two servings of squid ink!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Squid ink...? Wh-Why would you need 
something like that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You know what I mean! Switch up the 
flavor! Once you get bored of it, there's 
no moves or revolutions to speak of!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Eating it all without mixing up the flavor 
would be totally boring!
